name: Create a schedule and retain it after reload
description: Checks a schedule can be saved and remains visible after reloading.
steps: Enter a schedule name and time
Select Monday and save the schedule
expected: The new schedule is still visible after refresh.

name: Edit, disable, and delete a schedule
description: Checks schedule actions update persisted state and destructive actions are confirmed.
expected: The edited title is shown, the switch changes state, and the deleted schedule disappears.

name: Create and delete a quick note
description: Checks notes can be added, rendered, and removed from saved state.
steps: Enter a title and details and add the note
expected: The note appears after saving and disappears after confirmed deletion.

name: Reject schedule without repeat days
description: Checks the form prevents saving a schedule without selecting at least one day.
steps: Open the schedule form on mobile
Enter a title and time but select no days
expected: A visible validation message asks for at least one repeat day and no schedule is added.

name: Search schedules and keep alarm controls available
description: Checks search filters the schedule list and alarm overlay offers snooze and dismiss controls.
steps: Create two schedules with different titles
Trigger an alarm by setting a matching enabled time and day
expected: Only matching schedules appear in search results and the alarm overlay provides snooze and dismiss.
